description: Ask Jale for the price to run next in one of your experiments: it simulates each candidate price against the experiment's results so far and returns the best one for your objective with its expected effect and how confident it is. Pass experiment_id. Optionally pass objective (revenue, conversion, profit or market share, default revenue), candidates (the prices to compare, otherwise a grid is chosen) and lookback_days. It recommends only; it changes no price. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

candidates.description: The prices to compare. Otherwise a grid is chosen.

experiment_id.description: The experiment to recommend a price for.

lookback_days.description: How many days of results to learn from.

objective.description: What to optimise for. Defaults to revenue.

name: recommend_jale_price
